title: Search-backed List must emit continuation token when auth filtering shrinks a page
answers: Why does paging through a search-backed list silently skip or miss resources?
List stops returning NextPageToken even though more authorized items exist
How should authorization filtering interact with list pagination tokens?
Continuation token missing after RBAC/authz filters out rows from a full page
body:
Symptom: a client paging through a search-backed LIST (via list_with_selectors) stops receiving a NextPageToken even though unauthorized/filtered rows mean more matching resources remain, so later pages are silently lost.
Root cause: listWithSelectors only looked at the raw search page size vs limit to decide whether to continue; it didn't account for authorization filtering shrinking a full page, or for post-rank authorization returning a short page when the search total was inexact (pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go:listWithSelectors).
Fix pattern: after building the response rows, call searchListNeedsContinue(limit, rowCount, totalHitsExact) — continue if limit>0 and rowCount>0 and (rowCount>=limit OR total is inexact) — and if so build a token from the last scanned row's sortFields plus the original listRv (not a new RV), via NewSearchContinueToken.
Constraints: only applies to search/index-backed LIST paths using sortFields-based continuation; if the last row has no sortFields the code logs a warning and returns no token (can't safely continue) instead of guessing. The token must reuse the request's original listRv so results stay pinned to one consistent snapshot across pages.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/resource list_with_selectors.go and any search-backed LIST path with authorization filtering or inexact totals
